daemonErrors.delivery_in_progress: Delivery is already in progress. No need to send again; recipient status will update when it finishes ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.delivery_ambiguous: Delivery may already have occurred. Check the member's terminal or wait for a reply; if you need to send it again, reopen recipient status and use "Retry anyway" ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.already_delivered: This message was already handed to the runtime. No need to send it again ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.shutdown_in_progress: CCCC is restarting or stopping. Try again in a moment ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.daemon_unavailable: The CCCC daemon is not responding right now. Once it recovers, check whether your last action took effect before trying again ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.path_not_found: That directory or its parent folder could not be found. Check the path or use Browse to pick an existing folder ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.not_dir: This path or one of its parent paths is not a folder. Check the directory path and its parent folders, or pick an existing folder ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.invalid_project_root: The project directory bound to this Group is missing or inaccessible. Check that it still exists, or re-attach a valid directory ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.no_enabled_recipients: No members can receive this message. Add a member first or choose different recipients ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.file_too_large: This file exceeds the upload size limit. Try a smaller file, or pin a URL or choose a workspace file instead ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.actor_browser_busy: The browser is delivering work. Wait for it to finish, then try again ({{code}}).
daemonErrors.actor_switch_pending: Finish the previous switch first. Refresh the page, then choose Retry completion on the member ({{code}}).
